# NETRA LLM Gateway

> High-throughput, ultra-low latency intelligent gateway and semantic vector caching infrastructure for production Generative AI applications.

## Technical Baseline
- Core Runtime: Java 25 LTS, Spring Boot 4.1.1, Gradle 9 Kotlin DSL on Java Virtual Threads.
- Storage: PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector extension (384-dimension vector index), Redis 8.0 Lua JIT.
- Semantic Engine: In-JVM ONNX transformer models (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) for sub-4ms embedding generation.

## Key APIs
- `POST /v1/chat/completions`: OpenAI-compatible endpoint supporting streaming SSE and non-streaming responses.
- `GET /health`: Health and readiness probe.

## Telemetry Response Headers
- `x-netra-provider`: Upstream provider identifier (e.g. alpha/alpha-small)
- `x-netra-cache`: Cache outcome (hit or miss)
- `x-netra-fallback`: Failover flag (true or false)
- `x-netra-cost-usd`: Precise cost in micro-USD (0.000000 USD)
